verdict.rationale: Railway is a cloud platform with built-in AI features (the Railway Agent and cloud agents), so asking whether customer data is excluded from AI model training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack has no documented training opt-out, no data-usage policy and no no-training commitment. The AI-feature docs cover only what the agent can do, not how customer data is handled for model training.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
